selection_rationale.astra-earlytable: Runtime control; same representation as baseline.
selection_rationale.astra-sparse12: Best gate/visibility candidate on screen64; validate selected result on unused seeds.
selection_rationale.astra-research-escape: Seven-sheet structural alternative; screen64 is inconclusive, evaluate development potential.
selection_rationale.astra-privategate: One private generic window; initial16 inconclusive, retain for mechanism test.

metric: mean of 100*log(candidate score / baseline score); paired standard error
interpretation: 500-case research comparison, not a submission adoption gate; no claim about official ranking
